lean.statement:
∀ {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ),
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
            ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose)) *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let f : (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        (Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖z.2‖ ^ 2) * p z.1 z.2)
    let g : (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ × EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) → ℝ :=
      fun z => (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        Real.sqrt ((((κ + 1) / 2) • (1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) - ((κ - 1) / 4) • ((z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) + (z.1 : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).transpose))).det /
          (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) * Real.exp (-a z.1 * ‖z.2‖ ^ 2 / 4)
    Integrable f (((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))).prod volume) ∧
    Integrable g (((Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))).prod volume) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det *
        (∫ x : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n), Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2) * p O x)
        ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ)))) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) /
            (a O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ∂(Measure.haarMeasure (⊤ : PositiveCompacts (Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ))))
approved_definition_context: The full real orthogonal group has inherited matrix topology and Borel sets, both determinant signs. Measure.haarMeasure on top is its actual normalized probability; product is with the canonical volume on actual EuclideanSpace R (Fin n).

The norm is the true Euclidean norm, not the coordinate sup norm; WithLp.ofLp supplies real coordinates. All lets are literal real formulas, not a characterized Gaussian law or assumed probability density.

Integrable is genuine absolute Bochner L1 under the displayed product law. Both joint assertions are outputs, without a caller majorant or Fubini premise. The integral convention is Mathlib Bochner integration.
All dimension-half exponents use real n/2 and nonnegative Real.sqrt; natural n-1 is natural subtraction. Source first coordinate is zero-based j0; ell0 is included.
